CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to identified content found.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) is explicitly listed and an origin/representation status is given for the same referent/time, satisfying C, O and D bindings.

A.rationale: No statement linking attention/allocation or processing condition to the organization/presentation/access of an identified content.

C.rationale: Report identifies specific content instances (color-labeled cell sets) with explicit attribute labels.

D.rationale: Content entries are given separately from their origin/representation metadata, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: The report explicitly gives origin/representation metadata describing how the content is represented (kind and represented_time).
